stem.text: The structure of compound G is shown.

stem.alt: Displayed structure of compound G: CH2=C with a C≡N group above the C, and a C(=O)-OCH3 group below.

stem.text: Which diagram shows the repeat unit of the polymer formed?

A.alt: Displayed polymer repeat unit in brackets with a C≡N group and a C=O group on the chain.

B.alt: Displayed polymer repeat unit in brackets with H and CO2CH3 groups and a C=N group on the chain.

C.alt: Displayed polymer repeat unit in brackets with a CH2 group, a C≡N group and a CO2CH3 group on the chain.

D.alt: Displayed polymer repeat unit in brackets with a C=N group, a C=CH2 group and a CO2CH3 group.
